issues.title: 给 Claude 一条干净的线路：一台 VPS 和两台虚拟机
issues.body:
![给 Claude 一条干净的线路](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hychiiu/hychiiu-blog/assets/posts/claude-vm-vps/cover-v2.webp) 用 Claude 一段时间以后，我最在意的已经不是速度，而是**出口稳不稳定、环境干不干净**。今天在这台机器上登录，明天换一条线路，后天浏览器时区又跟 IP 对不上，这种乱糟糟的状态我很不喜欢。 所以十月下旬花了两个晚上，把这件事做成了一套固定的东西： - 一台 Oracle Cloud 的 VPS，在美国西部，作为唯一的出口； - Mac 上的 VMware Fusion 跑两台虚拟机：一台 Debian 当网关，一台 Windows 11 专门用来干活； - Windows 里**不装任何代理软件**，它只连着一张“空”的隔离网，唯一能出去的路就是网关； - 网关一停，Windows 直接断网，不会悄悄换成我本机的出口； - VPS 上再跑一个 CLIProxyAPI：Claude 只在 Windows 里登录一次，别的设备通过它的 API 来用。 这篇把整个过程、配置和踩过的坑都记下来，方便以后重装时照着做，也给有类似想法的朋友参考。 > [!NOTE] > 本文只记录我自己的网络环境怎么搭，出发点是隐私和稳定。请遵守你所在地的法律法规和各个服务的使用条款。文中所有 IP、端口、UUID、密钥都已替换成 ``、``、`` 这样的占位符。 ## 整体结构 先看图，后面每一节对应图里的一块。 [![整体拓扑：Windows → 隔离网 → Debian 网关 → VMware NAT → Mac → 美国 VPS → Claude](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hychiiu/hychiiu-blog/assets/posts/claude-vm-vps/topology-v2.webp "图 1 · 整体拓扑")](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hychiiu/hychiiu-blog/assets/posts/claude-vm-vps/topology-v2.webp) 一个数据包从 Windows 出发，大致这样走： ```mermaid flowchart LR W["Windows 11"] -->|"隔离网"| G["Debian 网关
sing-box"] G -->|"VLESS-REALITY"| M["Mac
VMware NAT"] M -->|"绕过 TUN"| V["VPS
美国西部"] V --> C["Claude"] ``` 几台机器分工很明确： | 角色 | 系统 | 网卡 | 负责什么 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | VPS | Oracle Cloud · Ubuntu | 公网 `` | 跑 sing-box 服务端（VLESS-REALITY）和 CLIProxyAPI，是唯一的出口 | | 网关 `AIAgentGateway` | Debian 13 (trixie) | `enp2s0` NAT ＋ `enp10s0` 隔离网 | 发 DHCP、劫持 DNS、把所有流量塞进隧道 | | 工作机 | Windows 11 ARM | 只有隔离网一张 | 正常上网、登录账号，不知道代理的存在 | | 宿主机 | macOS · VMware Fusion | Wi‑Fi / 有线 | 跑虚拟机；自己的流量走 Egern，但要放过 VPS 那条连接 | | 其他设备 | 随意 | 随意 | 通过 CPA 的 API 用 Claude，自己不登录账号 | 为什么不直接在 Windows 里开个代理客户端？因为它依赖“我记得开、它也一直没掉”。系统代理不是所有程序都认；客户端一旦崩了或者断线，流量就会从本机出去，而且你多半不会马上发现。把“走不走代理”这件事从 Windows 里拿出去，交给一台专门的网关，Windows 就算想漏也没有路可走。 另外，我不太喜欢 Clash 系那套配置，这次从服务端到网关都用 sing-box，一个配置文件看到底。 ## 一、VPS：美国西部的那台机器 VPS 是 Oracle Cloud 上的一台 Ubuntu，区域在美国西部。节点用的是 [233boy 的 sing-box 脚本](https://github.com/233boy/sing-box)，默认就是 VLESS-REALITY，装完基本不用管。 ```bash title="VPS · 安装与常用命令" # 安装（以脚本文档为准） bash <(wget -qO- -o- https://github.com/233boy/sing-box/raw/main/install.sh) sing-box url # 打印 vless:// 链接，后面喂给网关 sing-box status # 运行状态 sing-box log # 看日志 sing-box port auto # 换端口 sing-box sni <域名> # 换 REALITY 的伪装站点 ``` 有几处值得提一下： - **Oracle 有两层防火墙**。控制台里的 Security List（或 NSG）要放行节点端口，机器里的 iptables 也要放行。只开一层，表现就是“端口不通”。我这台机器里的 INPUT 链默认就是放行的，问题一般出在控制台那层。 - **REALITY 伪装站点选一个稳定的大站**。脚本会帮你填一个默认值，但最好偶尔在 VPS 上 `curl -I` 一下它，确认它还能正常访问。 - **时区和语言**。既然出口在美国西部，VPS 我也顺手改成了太平洋时间（`America/Los_Angeles`），语言用美式英语： ```bash title="VPS · 时区与 locale" sudo timedatectl set-timezone America/Los_Angeles sudo apt install -y language-pack-en sudo localectl set-locale LANG=en_US.UTF-8 timedatectl # Time zone: America/Los_Angeles (PST, -0800) ``` > [!TIP] > `timedatectl set-timezone` 是永久的，重启也不会变。它只影响这台 VPS 本身，宿主机和已经在跑的 Docker 容器都不会跟着改。容器要用 `TZ=America/Los_Angeles` 环境变量，或者挂载 `/etc/localtime:/etc/localtime:ro`，改完重建容器才生效。 拿到 `sing-box url` 打印的链接，长这样（字段都换成了占位符）： ```text title="vless 链接结构" vless://@:?encryption=none&flow=xtls-rprx-vision&security=reality&sni=&fp=chrome&pbk=&sid=&type=tcp# ``` 这一整串就是网关需要的全部信息。**它等同于密码**，别贴到聊天记录、截图或者公开仓库里。 ## 二、在 Fusion 里搭两张网 这是整套方案的地基。核心只有一句话：**Windows 只能看到一张网，这张网里除了网关什么都没有。** [![VMware Fusion 的网卡分配：网关两张网卡，Windows 只接隔离网](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hychiiu/hychiiu-blog/assets/posts/claude-vm-vps/vmware-network.webp "图 2 · 两张网怎么接（示意）")](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hychiiu/hychiiu-blog/assets/posts/claude-vm-vps/vmware-network.webp) 具体做法： 1. 在 Fusion 的网络设置里新建一张自定义网络，我起名叫 **AI Agent Internet**； 2. 把“使用 NAT”“连接这台 Mac”“DHCP”三项**全部关掉**。这样它就是一根两头都没插东西的网线，子网和网关都由 Debian 自己来发； 3. 网关虚拟机加两张网卡：第一张用默认的 *Share with my Mac*（NAT），用来出网；第二张接 AI Agent Internet； 4. Windows 虚拟机**只留一张网卡**，接 AI Agent Internet。别图省事再加一张 NAT 当备用，那样 kill switch 就没用了。 | 虚拟机 | 网卡 | Fusion 网络 | 系统里的名字 | 地址 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | AIAgentGateway | NIC 1 | Share with my Mac（NAT） | `enp2s0` | `172.16.236.x`，DHCP | | AIAgentGateway | NIC 2 | AI Agent Internet | `enp10s0` | `10.10.10.1/24`，静态 | | Windows 11 | NIC 1 | AI Agent Internet | `Ethernet` | `10.10.10.100–200`，由网关 DHCP 分配 | > [!IMPORTANT] > 网卡名每台机器可能不一样（`ens160`、`enp2s0`……），不要照抄。下面的脚本会自己判断：**有默认路由的那张是上网口，另一张就是私有网口**。 ## 三、Debian 网关 网关装的是 Debian 13 (trixie)，最小安装，软件源换成了清华的 tuna 镜像。虚拟机文件夹的名字还写着 `Debian 12 AI Agent Gateway`，实际跑的是 13，别被名字骗了。 ### 3.1 先说几个小坑 - **Debian 默认没有 `sudo`**。`sudo: command not found` 不是你打错了，先 `su -` 切 root，或者装上 sudo 再把自己加进 sudo 组。 - **GitHub API 限流**。sing-box 官方的 `install.sh` 要去 GitHub 查最新版本，在国内的 NAT 后面经常被限流，装到一半就失败。后来我改成从 SagerNet 的 apt 源装，稳定很多： ```bash title="网关 · 从官方 apt 源安装 sing-box" mkdir -p /etc/apt/keyrings curl -fsSL https://sing-box.app/gpg.key -o /etc/apt/keyrings/sagernet.asc chmod a+r /etc/apt/keyrings/sagernet.asc cat > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/sagernet.sources <<'EOS' Types: deb URIs: https://deb.sagernet.org/ Suites: * Components: * Enabled: yes Signed-By: /etc/apt/keyrings/sagernet.asc EOS apt-get update && apt-get install -y sing-box ``` ### 3.2 一键脚本 网关的配置我写成了一个脚本 `setup-gateway.sh`，唯一的参数就是上面那串 vless 链接，换节点重跑一遍就行。踩过的坑都写进了注释里： ```bash title="setup-gateway.sh" collapse={20-47} #!/usr/bin/env bash # Debian + sing-box 透明代理网关 # 用法（root）：bash setup-gateway.sh 'vless://@:?...' set -euo pipefail LINK="${1:?请传入 vless:// 链接}" CONF="${SB_CONF:-/etc/sing-box/config.json}" # 上网口 = 有默认路由的网卡；私有网口 = 另一张网卡 WAN=$(ip route show default | awk '{print $5; exit}') LAN=$(ls /sys/class/net | grep -v -E "^(lo|tun.*|$WAN)$" | head -n1) [ -n "$WAN" ] && [ -n "$LAN" ] || { echo "没找到两张网卡，请检查虚拟机网卡设置"; exit 1; } echo "上网口: $WAN 私有网口: $LAN" LAN_IP=10.10.10.1 if [ -z "${SKIP_SYSTEM:-}" ]; then apt-get update && apt-get install -y curl dnsmasq python3 # 1. LAN 静态地址 cat > /etc/network/interfaces.d/lan < /etc/sysctl.d/99-fwd.conf && sysctl --system >/dev/null # 3. DHCP（只发地址，DNS 交给 sing-box 劫持） cat > /etc/dnsmasq.d/lan.conf </dev/null; then mkdir -p /etc/apt/keyrings curl -fsSL https://sing-box.app/gpg.key -o /etc/apt/keyrings/sagernet.asc chmod a+r /etc/apt/keyrings/sagernet.asc printf 'Types: deb\nURIs: https://deb.sagernet.org/\nSuites: *\nComponents: *\nEnabled: yes\nSigned-By: /etc/apt/keyrings/sagernet.asc\n' \ > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/sagernet.sources apt-get update && apt-get install -y sing-box fi fi # 5. 解析 vless 链接生成配置 mkdir -p "$(dirname "$CONF")" python3 - "$LINK" "$WAN" "$CONF" <<'PY' import sys, json, urllib.parse as u link, wan, conf = sys.argv[1:4] l = u.urlparse(link); q = dict(u.parse_qsl(l.query)) node = {"type": "vless", "tag": "my-node", "server": l.hostname, "server_port": l.port or 443, "uuid": u.unquote(l.username), "flow": q.get("flow", ""), "tls": {"enabled": True, "server_name": q.get("sni", ""), "utls": {"enabled": True, "fingerprint": q.get("fp", "chrome")}, "reality": {"enabled": True, "public_key": q.get("pbk", ""), "short_id": q.get("sid", "")}}} cfg = { "log": {"level": "warn"}, "dns": {"servers": [{"type": "https", "tag": "remote", "server": "1.1.1.1", "detour": "my-node"}]}, "inbounds": [{"type": "tun", "tag": "tun-in", "address": ["172.19.0.1/30"], "auto_route": True, "auto_redirect": True, "strict_route": True}], "outbounds": [node, {"type": "direct", "tag": "direct"}], "route": { "rules": [ {"action": "sniff"}, {"protocol": "dns", "action": "hijack-dns"}, # 连节点本身的流量必须直连，否则会“自己代理自己” {"ip_cidr": [f"{l.hostname}/32"], "outbound": "direct"}, ], "final": "my-node", # 这台 VM 上 auto_detect_interface 会报 missing default interface，直接写死上网口 "default_interface": wan, }, } json.dump(cfg, open(conf, "w"), indent=2) PY sing-box check -c "$CONF" [ -n "${SKIP_SYSTEM:-}" ] && exit 0 systemctl enable sing-box && systemctl restart sing-box echo "完成：Windows 接到私有网络后会自动拿到 10.10.10.x 地址。" echo "检查状态: systemctl status sing-box ; 换节点: 重新运行本脚本并传入新链接" ``` 用起来就一行： ```bash su - bash /home/hychiiu/setup-gateway.sh 'vless://@:?...' ``` > [!TIP] > 想先看看生成的配置对不对，可以加两个环境变量做一次“干跑”，只生成配置、跑 `sing-box check`，不动系统： > `SKIP_SYSTEM=1 SB_CONF=/tmp/test.json bash setup-gateway.sh '<链接>'` ### 3.3 配置要点 脚本第 5 步生成的就是全部配置，记住四点就够了： - **TUN 接管一切**：`auto_route` ＋ `auto_redirect` 把本机和转发进来的流量都收进 `tun0`，`strict_route` 不留缝； - **DNS 也进隧道**：`hijack-dns` 截下 Windows 的 53 端口请求，再经 `my-node` 用 DoH 解析； - **节点 IP 直连**，不然会自己代理自己； - **不用手写 NAT**：dnsmasq 只发地址（`port=0`），转发靠 `ip_forward`，nftables 规则 sing-box 自己会配。 ### 3.4 systemd apt 装的 sing-box 自带 systemd 服务，读 `/etc/sing-box/` 下的配置，开机自启： ```bash title="网关 · 日常看状态" systemctl is-active sing-box dnsmasq # 两个都该是 active systemctl status sing-box --no-pager -l journalctl -u sing-box -n 50 --no-pager ip -br a | grep -E 'tun|enp' curl -s https://api.ipify.org; echo # 应该是 ``` [![网关和 Windows 各自看到的网络](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hychiiu/hychiiu-blog/assets/posts/claude-vm-vps/term-gateway.webp "图 3 · 网关的路由表和 Windows 的 ipconfig（真实输出，有删节）")](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hychiiu/hychiiu-blog/assets/posts/claude-vm-vps/term-gateway.webp) ### 3.5 Kill switch 这套设计最让我安心的就是这一点：**不需要额外的规则，kill switch 是网络拓扑本身给的。** [![网关在线与关机时的对比](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hychiiu/hychiiu-blog/assets/posts/claude-vm-vps/killswitch-v2.webp "图 4 · 网关一停，Windows 就断网")](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hychiiu/hychiiu-blog/assets/posts/claude-vm-vps/killswitch-v2.webp) Windows 只有一张网卡，那张网卡所在的网里没有 NAT、没有宿主机、没有 DHCP 服务器，只有网关。所以： - 网关虚拟机关机或挂起：Windows 没有任何路由能出去，**直接断网**； - 网关开着、sing-box 正常：所有流量进 TUN，从美国那台 VPS 出去； - 网关开着、sing-box 挂了：转发过去的包源地址还是 `10.10.10.x`，网关上没有做 NAT，VMware 的 NAT 不认这个网段，回程的包回不来，多半也是出不去。 第三种情况我是靠“没有 NAT 规则”来兜底的，算不上严格。想再保险一点，可以加一条显式的规则，禁止私有网口直接转发到上网口（**这条我自己还没长期跑过**，仅供参考）： ```bash title="可选 · /etc/killswitch.nft" table inet killswitch { chain forward { type filter hook forward priority 0; policy accept; iifname "enp10s0" oifname "enp2s0" drop } } ``` 用 `nft -f /etc/killswitch.nft` 加载。TUN 接管的流量出口是 `tun0`，不受这条影响，它只在 sing-box 不在的时候起作用。 > [!WARNING] > Debian 自带的 `/etc/nftables.conf` 第一行是 `flush ruleset`。如果你把规则写进那个文件再重载，sing-box 自己建的表也会被一起清掉，重载完记得 `systemctl restart sing-box`。 ## 四、Windows：让它看起来就“在美国” Windows 里什么代理都不用装。插上 AI Agent Internet 这根网线，开机就能从网关拿到 `10.10.10.1xx` 的地址，网关和 DNS 都是 `10.10.10.1`。 剩下要做的是让系统环境和出口对得上。出口在美国西部，Windows 的时区就设成太平洋时间： [![出口位置、Windows 时区、语言三者的对应](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hychiiu/hychiiu-blog/assets/posts/claude-vm-vps/timezone-v2.webp "图 5 · 出口在哪，时间就在哪")](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hychiiu/hychiiu-blog/assets/posts/claude-vm-vps/timezone-v2.webp) ```powershell title="Windows · 时区" tzutil /g # 查看当前时区 ID tzutil /s "Pacific Standard Time" # (UTC-08:00) Pacific Time (US & Canada)，夏令时自动切换 Get-TimeZone ``` 语言基本不用动。系统本来就是英文版，显示语言保持 English (United States)，正好和出口对得上，只在输入法里加了中文，平时打字方便： ```powershell title="Windows · 语言与输入法" Get-WinSystemLocale Get-Culture Get-WinUserLanguageList # 保持英文界面，追加中文输入 $list = Get-WinUserLanguageList $list.Add("zh-CN") Set-WinUserLanguageList $list -Force ``` > [!WARNING] > 设置里“自动设置时区”建议关掉。它会按位置服务去猜时区，猜出来的结果不一定和出口一致，哪天自己变回 UTC+8 都不知道。 ## 五、CLIProxyAPI：在 Windows 里登录一次，别处都能用 环境是干净了，但我不可能所有活都在虚拟机里干：Mac 终端里的 Claude Code、别的电脑，也想用同一个账号。要是每台设备各自登录一遍，又回到了“今天这里、明天那里”的老样子。 所以我在同一台 VPS 上又跑了一个 [CLIProxyAPI](https://github.com/router-for-me/CLIProxyAPI)（下面简称 CPA）。它能通过 OAuth 登录 Claude Code 的账号，再把它包成 Anthropic / OpenAI 兼容的 API。分工是这样的： - **登录只做一次，在 Windows 里做**。走的是那条干净的线路，浏览器、时区、出口都对得上； - **凭证留在 VPS 上**。CPA 把 OAuth 凭证存在自己的 auth 目录里，过期会自己刷新； - **别的设备只拿一个 API Key**。它们请求 CPA，CPA 再从 VPS 去请求 Claude，所以 Claude 看到的出口还是这台 VPS，和 Windows 是同一个。 [![CPA：Windows 登录一次，其他设备用 API Key 调用](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hychiiu/hychiiu-blog/assets/posts/claude-vm-vps/cpa-flow.webp "图 6 · 登录一次，到处调用")](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hychiiu/hychiiu-blog/assets/posts/claude-vm-vps/cpa-flow.webp) ### 5.1 部署 我用 Docker Compose 跑官方镜像 `eceasy/cli-proxy-api`。端口只绑在本机，对外交给 Caddy 反代成 HTTPS： ```yaml title="VPS · docker-compose.yml（节选）" services: cli-proxy-api: image: eceasy/cli-proxy-api:latest restart: unless-stopped ports: - "127.0.0.1::" # 只给本机的 Caddy 用 environment: - TZ=America/Los_Angeles volumes: - ./cli-proxy-api/config.yaml:/CLIProxyAPI/config.yaml - ./cli-proxy-api/auth:/root/.cli-proxy-api # OAuth 凭证在这里 - /etc/localtime:/etc/localtime:ro ``` `config.yaml` 从仓库里的 `config.example.yaml` 复制一份，改这几项就能跑： ```yaml title="VPS · config.yaml（节选，v8 写法）" config-version: 8 server: port: management: allow-remote: true # 要在别的机器上开管理面板才需要 secret-key: "" access: api-keys: - "" # 给客户端用的 key，不是 Claude 的 ``` ```text title="VPS · /etc/caddy/Caddyfile" <你的域名> { reverse_proxy 127.0.0.1: } ``` `docker compose up -d` 起来以后，`docker compose logs -f cli-proxy-api` 看一眼没有报错就行。 > [!TIP] > 这里有三个小坑： > 1. `api-keys` 还是示例里的占位值时，CPA 会进安全模式，API 全部关掉，换成自己的 key 才能用； > 2. 容器时区用 `TZ` 加挂载 `/etc/localtime` 就够了，别再去挂 `/etc/timezone`，会报 `not a directory`； > 3. Caddy 配置里如果写了日志文件，`/var/log/caddy` 目录要先建好并 `chown caddy:caddy`，不然 Caddy 起不来。 ### 5.2 在 Windows 里登录 这是整套环境里唯一需要“人”在场的一步，所以放在最干净的那台机器上做： 1. 在 Windows 的浏览器里打开管理面板。CPA 自带一个，地址是 `https://<你的域名>/management.html`，用上面的 `secret-key` 登录（我用的是社区的 cpa-manager-plus，用法差不多）； 2. 在面板里发起 Claude 的 OAuth 登录，拿到授权链接，在**同一个浏览器**里打开，登录账号并授权； 3. 授权完浏览器会跳到一个 `localhost` 的回调地址。CPA 不在 Windows 上，这个页面多半打不开，不用管，把地址栏里的完整 URL 复制下来粘回面板提交就行； 4. 面板里出现这个账号、状态正常，就登录好了。 ### 5.3 在别的设备上用 Claude Code 只要两个环境变量： ```bash title="任意设备 · Claude Code" export ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL="https://<你的域名>" export ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN="" claude ``` OpenAI 兼容的客户端，Base URL 填 `https://<你的域名>/v1`，Key 填同一个。先用一条 curl 确认通了： ```bash curl -s https://<你的域名>/v1/models -H "Authorization: Bearer " ``` > [!CAUTION] > CPA 背后是你自己的账号。API Key 和管理密钥都要够长，别外传；这套只给自己的设备用，别拿去分享给别人，既不安全，也违反服务条款。 ## 六、Mac 这边：TUN 和网关抢路 这一节是我花时间最多的地方。 我的 Mac 平时开着 Egern，TUN 模式（`vif_only: true`），还劫持了全部 DNS（`hijack_dns: *:53`）。问题在于，**网关通过 VMware NAT 发出去的流量，在 Mac 看来就是一台普通的本机流量**，于是也被 Egern 的 TUN 收了进去，转给了别的节点。 [![Mac 上的 TUN 截走了网关连 VPS 的流量](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hychiiu/hychiiu-blog/assets/posts/claude-vm-vps/egern-bypass-v2.webp "图 7 · 绕过之前和之后")](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hychiiu/hychiiu-blog/assets/posts/claude-vm-vps/egern-bypass-v2.webp) 这会导致两个现象： 1. **网关自己解析不了域名**。Egern 劫持了 53 端口，VMware NAT 自带的 DNS（`172.16.236.2`）跟着失效。我在网关的 `/etc/resolv.conf.head` 里写死了一个公共 DNS 绕开它。顺带一提，看到解析结果是 `198.18.x.x` 这种地址，基本就是 fake-ip 在作怪。 2. **REALITY 握手失败**。VLESS 连接被包了一层又转出去，到了 VPS 那头，服务端日志里全是 `REALITY: processed invalid connection`。 最直接的验证是把 Egern 整个关掉：一关，网关马上就通了，原因也就坐实了。但我不想为了虚拟机让 Mac 裸奔，所以长期的办法是让 VPS 那个 IP 完全不进 Egern 的隧道，直接走物理网卡： ```yaml title="Egern 配置（片段）" bypass_tunnel_proxy: - "/32" vif_excluded_routes: - "/32" ``` `bypass_tunnel_proxy` 让这个地址不走代理，`vif_excluded_routes` 才是真正把它从虚拟网卡的路由里踢出去的那一项。换别的客户端也一样：**给 VPS 的 IP 加一条 DIRECT，并且确认它的路由不经过 utun**。 > [!CAUTION] > 我在这里栽过两次： > 1. 改完配置只点了“重新加载”，路由没刷新。要**断开再连接**一次才生效。 > 2. 我改的是自己保存的那份配置，Egern 实际加载的却是 `~/Library/Group Containers/…/Local/` 下面的一份旧副本，里面根本没有这条规则。改之前先确认它真正在用的是哪个文件。 验证方法很简单：在 Mac 上 `route -n get `，看出口网卡是 `en0` 之类的物理网卡，而不是 `utun*`。 ## 七、让网关在后台安静地跑 网关不需要图形界面，每次开 Fusion 还多一个窗口挺烦。Fusion 自带 `vmrun`，可以无窗口启动： ```bash title="Mac · ~/.zshrc" VMRUN="/Applications/VMware Fusion.app/Contents/Library/vmrun" GW_VMX="$HOME/Virtual Machines.localized/Debian 12 AI Agent Gateway.vmwarevm/Debian 12 AI Agent Gateway.vmx" alias gw-up='"$VMRUN" -T fusion start "$GW_VMX" nogui' alias gw-down='"$VMRUN" -T fusion stop "$GW_VMX" soft' alias gw-ip='"$VMRUN" -T fusion getGuestIPAddress "$GW_VMX" -wait' alias vms='"$VMRUN" list' ``` 平时 `gw-up` 一下，等十几秒再开 Windows 就行。要进网关就 `ssh hychiiu@<网关的 NAT 地址>`，`gw-ip` 能查到它在 `172.16.236.x` 上的地址。 > [!TIP] > 启动顺序是**先网关、后 Windows**。反过来也没事，只是 Windows 一开始拿不到 DHCP 地址，等网关起来后在 Windows 里 `ipconfig /renew` 一下就好。 ## 八、检查清单 换节点、改配置之后，按这张清单从里到外过一遍： [![八项检查](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hychiiu/hychiiu-blog/assets/posts/claude-vm-vps/checklist-v2.webp "图 8 · 检查清单")](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hychiiu/hychiiu-blog/assets/posts/claude-vm-vps/checklist-v2.webp) | # | 检查什么 | 在哪做 | 怎么算通过 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | 1 | 网关出口 | 网关 | `curl -s https://api.ipify.org` 返回 `` | | 2 | Windows 的地址 | Windows | `ipconfig /all`：`10.10.10.1xx`，网关和 DNS 都是 `10.10.10.1` | | 3 | 浏览器里的 IP | Windows 浏览器 | 任意 IP 查询页显示美国，位置和 VPS 的区域一致 | | 4 | DNS 泄漏 | Windows 浏览器 | DNS leak test 的扩展测试里看不到国内运营商的解析服务器 | | 5 | WebRTC | Windows 浏览器 | WebRTC 泄漏测试里没有真实公网 IP | | 6 | 时区 | Windows | `tzutil /g` 是 `Pacific Standard Time`，浏览器 `Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone` 是 `America/Los_Angeles` | | 7 | Kill switch | Mac + Windows | `gw-down` 以后，Windows 里 `ping 8.8.8.8` 不通 | | 8 | CPA | 任意设备 | `curl https://<你的域名>/v1/models` 带上 Key 能返回模型列表 | 第 6 项可以直接在浏览器控制台里看： ```js title="浏览器控制台" Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone // "America/Los_Angeles" new Date().getTimezoneOffset() // 480，也就是 UTC-8（夏令时是 420） ``` ## 九、关于 Claude 的几点 环境搭好以后，Claude 账号的登录只在这台 Windows 里做，包括授权给 CPA 的那一次；别的设备只用 CPA 的 Key，不直接登录。几点体会： - **出口固定比什么都重要**。同一个账号，今天一个国家，明天另一个国家，比用哪家 VPS 更容易出问题。现在不管是 Windows 的浏览器，还是经 CPA 发出去的请求，都只有美国这一个出口。 - **时区、语言和出口对齐**。这是第四节做的事。不用做到偏执，但别出现“IP 在美国、系统时间是北京时间”这种一眼就能看出来的矛盾。 - **Mac 上的 Claude Code 走 CPA**。它不经过虚拟机网关，靠 `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` 指向自己的 CPA。以前用第三方中转时踩到过一个坑：有些中转只接受官方 CLI 发出的请求，Claude Code Desktop 发的请求会被拒，表现为 preflight 阶段提示“请升级 Claude Code”。这不是版本问题，换回 CLI 就好。Desktop 怎么接自己的服务我还在折腾，以后有结论再写。 ## 十、我踩过的坑 把这段时间遇到的问题按“症状 → 原因 → 解决”整理一下，下次再遇到直接查表： | 症状 | 原因 | 解决 | | --- | --- | --- | | `install.sh` 装 sing-box 半路失败 | GitHub API 限流 | 改用 `deb.sagernet.org` 的 apt 源 | | sing-box 起不来，报 `missing default interface` | 这台 VM 上 `auto_detect_interface` 识别不到 | `route.default_interface` 写成 `enp2s0` | | `sudo: command not found` | Debian 最小安装不带 sudo | `su -` 切 root | | 网关 `ping 8.8.8.8` 通，域名解析失败 | Mac 上的 Egern 劫持了 DNS，VMware NAT 的 DNS 失效 | `/etc/resolv.conf.head` 写一个公共 DNS | | 解析结果是 `198.18.x.x` | Mac 那边的 fake-ip | 同上，并让 VPS IP 绕过 TUN | | 日志里一堆 `outbound/vless[my-node]: EOF`、`context deadline exceeded`，端口却是通的 | 连节点本身的流量也走了 vless，自己代理自己 | 路由里给 `/32` 加 `direct` | | VPS 日志 `REALITY: processed invalid connection` | Mac 的 TUN 把网关的 VLESS 流量又转了一道 | Egern 里 `bypass_tunnel_proxy` ＋ `vif_excluded_routes` | | 改了 Egern 配置还是不行 | 只重新加载，没断开重连；或者改错了文件 | 断开再连接；确认实际加载的配置文件 | | CPA 的接口全部不可用，提示安全模式 | `api-keys` 还是示例值 | 换成自己的 key | | Caddy 起不来 | 日志目录 `/var/log/caddy` 不存在 | 建目录并 `chown caddy:caddy` | | 时区改了，担心影响握手 | 不会 | TLS / REALITY 看的是 UTC 时钟准不准，跟时区设成哪里无关 | [![那次断网的排查过程](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hychiiu/hychiiu-blog/assets/posts/claude-vm-vps/term-debug-v2.webp "图 9 · 服务都在，就是出不去（真实输出，有删节）")](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hychiiu/hychiiu-blog/assets/posts/claude-vm-vps/term-debug-v2.webp) 那次断网的排查过程很典型：`sing-box` 和 `dnsmasq` 都是 `active`，到节点的 TCP 也是通的，就是隧道建不起来。我先停掉 sing-box 测直连，确认 VMware NAT 本身没问题；再看 VPS 那头的日志，发现握手被判无效；最后才追到 Mac 上的 TUN。**从里往外，一层一层排除**，比一上来就换端口、换节点有效得多。 > [!TIP] > 排查时最有用的一条命令：先在网关上停掉 sing-box，`curl -s https://api.ipify.org` 看直连能不能通。能通，就说明问题在隧道或节点；不通，就是 Fusion、Mac 或者上游的问题。测完记得 `systemctl start sing-box` 拉回来，否则 kill switch 的保护也没了。 ## 写在最后 回头看，这套东西真正起作用的是两个决定： 1. **把“走不走代理”从工作机里拿出去**。Windows 不知道代理的存在，也就没有“代理掉了”这回事； 2. **让断网成为默认状态**。隔离网里没有别的出口，网关不在就什么都不通。安全不靠我记得开代理，靠网线本身。 剩下的，sing-box、REALITY、时区，都是细节，换成别的工具也一样成立。CPA 则把“在干净的环境里登录一次”变成了“在哪儿都能用”，出口却还是同一个。要换节点，在 VPS 上 `sing-box url` 拿到新链接，网关上重跑一遍脚本，五分钟就好。 如果你也在搭类似的环境，希望这篇能帮你少踩几个坑。有问题可以在下面留言。

issues.title: A clean path to Claude: one VPS and two VMs
issues.body:
![A clean path to Claude](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hychiiu/hychiiu-blog/assets/posts/claude-vm-vps/cover-v2.webp) After using Claude for a while, I stopped caring as much about speed and started caring about whether the **egress was stable and the environment was clean**. Signing in on this machine today, hopping to another route tomorrow, then finding the browser timezone no longer matches the IP — I really dislike that kind of mess. So in late October I spent two evenings turning it into something fixed: - An Oracle Cloud VPS in the US West, as the only egress; - Two VMware Fusion VMs on the Mac: Debian as the gateway, and a Windows 11 machine that actually does the work; - **No proxy software on Windows.** It is attached to a deliberately empty isolated network, and the gateway is the only way out; - If the gateway stops, Windows loses the network immediately. It cannot quietly fall back to my Mac's own egress; - CLIProxyAPI also runs on the VPS. Claude is signed in once from Windows; other devices use it through that API. This post is a record of the whole setup, the configs, and the traps I hit, so I can follow it the next time I reinstall — and so it might save someone with a similar idea a few evenings. > [!NOTE] > This is only a write-up of how I built my own network, for privacy and stability. Follow the laws where you are and the terms of the services you use. Every IP, port, UUID, and secret in this post has been replaced with placeholders such as ``, ``, and ``. ## The overall shape Start with the picture. Each section below maps to a part of it. [![Overall topology: Windows → isolated network → Debian gateway → VMware NAT → Mac → US VPS → Claude](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hychiiu/hychiiu-blog/assets/posts/claude-vm-vps/topology-v2.webp "Fig. 1 · Overall topology")](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hychiiu/hychiiu-blog/assets/posts/claude-vm-vps/topology-v2.webp) A packet leaving Windows roughly follows this path: ```mermaid flowchart LR W["Windows 11"] -->|"isolated net"| G["Debian gateway
sing-box"] G -->|"VLESS-REALITY"| M["Mac
VMware NAT"] M -->|"bypass TUN"| V["VPS
US West"] V --> C["Claude"] ``` The machines have clear jobs: | Role | System | NICs | What it does | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | VPS | Oracle Cloud · Ubuntu | Public `` | Runs the sing-box server (VLESS-REALITY) and CLIProxyAPI; this is the only egress | | Gateway `AIAgentGateway` | Debian 13 (trixie) | `enp2s0` NAT + `enp10s0` isolated net | Serves DHCP, hijacks DNS, and stuffs all traffic into the tunnel | | Workstation | Windows 11 ARM | Isolated net only | Browses and signs in as usual; it has no idea a proxy exists | | Host | macOS · VMware Fusion | Wi‑Fi / Ethernet | Runs the VMs; its own traffic goes through Egern, except the VPS path, which must be exempted | | Other devices | Whatever | Whatever | Use Claude through CPA's API and never sign into the account themselves | Why not just run a proxy client on Windows? Because that only works for as long as I remember to turn it on and it stays up. Not every program honors the system proxy; if the client crashes or drops, traffic leaves from the host, and you usually do not notice right away. Taking “whether this goes through a proxy” out of Windows and handing it to a dedicated gateway means Windows has no other path even if it wants one. I also do not particularly like Clash-style configs. This time I used sing-box from the server all the way to the gateway, so there is one config file to read end to end. > [!NOTE] > Several diagrams in this post still have Chinese labels. They were drawn as bitmaps, and I do not have English source files for them yet. The Mermaid chart, the tables, and the English captions describe the same setup. Figures 3 and 9 are real (edited) terminal output; the captions around those frames are also still in Chinese. ## 1. The VPS in the US West The VPS is an Ubuntu machine on Oracle Cloud, in a US West region. The node is installed with [233boy's sing-box script](https://github.com/233boy/sing-box), which defaults to VLESS-REALITY. Once it is in, I mostly leave it alone. ```bash title="VPS · install and everyday commands" # Install (follow the script's own docs) bash <(wget -qO- -o- https://github.com/233boy/sing-box/raw/main/install.sh) sing-box url # print the vless:// link, later fed to the gateway sing-box status # running state sing-box log # logs sing-box port auto # rotate the port sing-box sni # change the REALITY camouflage site ``` A few things worth calling out: - **Oracle has two firewalls.** The Security List (or NSG) in the console has to allow the node port, and so does iptables on the machine. Open only one layer and the symptom is simply “the port is unreachable.” On this box the INPUT chain already defaults to allow, so the problem is usually the console layer. - **Pick a stable, well-known site for REALITY camouflage.** The script fills in a default, but it is worth an occasional `curl -I` from the VPS to confirm that site still answers. - **Timezone and locale.** Since the egress is in the US West, I also set the VPS itself to Pacific Time (`America/Los_Angeles`) and US English: ```bash title="VPS · timezone and locale" sudo timedatectl set-timezone America/Los_Angeles sudo apt install -y language-pack-en sudo localectl set-locale LANG=en_US.UTF-8 timedatectl # Time zone: America/Los_Angeles (PST, -0800) ``` > [!TIP] > `timedatectl set-timezone` is permanent; it survives a reboot. It only affects the VPS itself — the Mac and any Docker containers already running do not follow along. For containers, set `TZ=America/Los_Angeles` or bind-mount `/etc/localtime:/etc/localtime:ro`, then recreate the container for it to take effect. The link printed by `sing-box url` looks like this (every field is a placeholder): ```text title="vless link shape" vless://@:?encryption=none&flow=xtls-rprx-vision&security=reality&sni=&fp=chrome&pbk=&sid=&type=tcp# ``` That entire string is everything the gateway needs. **Treat it like a password.** Do not paste it into chat logs, screenshots, or a public repository. ## 2. Two networks in Fusion This is the foundation of the whole design. The rule is one sentence: **Windows can only see one network, and that network has nothing on it except the gateway.** [![VMware Fusion NIC assignment: the gateway has two NICs, Windows is attached only to the isolated network](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hychiiu/hychiiu-blog/assets/posts/claude-vm-vps/vmware-network.webp "Fig. 2 · How the two networks are wired (diagram, not a screenshot of the app)")](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hychiiu/hychiiu-blog/assets/posts/claude-vm-vps/vmware-network.webp) What I actually did: 1. In Fusion's network settings, create a custom network. I named it **AI Agent Internet**; 2. Turn **off** “Use NAT,” “Connect to this Mac,” and “DHCP.” It is then just a cable with nothing plugged in at either end; the subnet and gateway are issued by Debian itself; 3. Give the gateway VM two NICs: the first uses the default *Share with my Mac* (NAT) for upstream access; the second is attached to AI Agent Internet; 4. Leave the Windows VM with **exactly one NIC**, attached to AI Agent Internet. Do not add a spare NAT “just in case” — that would defeat the kill switch. | VM | NIC | Fusion network | Name in the guest | Address | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | AIAgentGateway | NIC 1 | Share with my Mac (NAT) | `enp2s0` | `172.16.236.x`, DHCP | | AIAgentGateway | NIC 2 | AI Agent Internet | `enp10s0` | `10.10.10.1/24`, static | | Windows 11 | NIC 1 | AI Agent Internet | `Ethernet` | `10.10.10.100–200`, DHCP from the gateway | > [!IMPORTANT] > Interface names differ from machine to machine (`ens160`, `enp2s0`, …). Do not copy them blindly. The script below figures it out itself: **the NIC with a default route is the WAN, the other one is the private LAN.** ## 3. The Debian gateway The gateway is Debian 13 (trixie), a minimal install, with the apt sources pointed at Tsinghua's tuna mirror. The VM folder is still named `Debian 12 AI Agent Gateway`; it is actually running 13, so do not let the folder name fool you. ### 3.1 A few small traps first - **Debian does not ship `sudo` by default.** `sudo: command not found` is not a typo. Use `su -` to become root, or install sudo and add yourself to the sudo group. - **GitHub API rate limits.** The official sing-box `install.sh` talks to GitHub for the latest release, and from behind a domestic NAT that often gets throttled halfway through. I switched to installing from SagerNet's apt repo, which has been much more reliable: ```bash title="Gateway · install sing-box from the official apt repo" mkdir -p /etc/apt/keyrings curl -fsSL https://sing-box.app/gpg.key -o /etc/apt/keyrings/sagernet.asc chmod a+r /etc/apt/keyrings/sagernet.asc cat > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/sagernet.sources <<'EOS' Types: deb URIs: https://deb.sagernet.org/ Suites: * Components: * Enabled: yes Signed-By: /etc/apt/keyrings/sagernet.asc EOS apt-get update && apt-get install -y sing-box ``` ### 3.2 A one-shot script I turned the gateway setup into a script, `setup-gateway.sh`. Its only argument is the vless link from earlier; to change nodes, run it again. The traps I hit are in the comments: ```bash title="setup-gateway.sh" collapse={20-47} #!/usr/bin/env bash # Debian + sing-box transparent proxy gateway # Usage (root): bash setup-gateway.sh 'vless://@:?...' set -euo pipefail LINK="${1:?please pass a vless:// link}" CONF="${SB_CONF:-/etc/sing-box/config.json}" # WAN = the NIC with a default route; LAN = the other NIC WAN=$(ip route show default | awk '{print $5; exit}') LAN=$(ls /sys/class/net | grep -v -E "^(lo|tun.*|$WAN)$" | head -n1) [ -n "$WAN" ] && [ -n "$LAN" ] || { echo "couldn't find two NICs, check the VM network settings"; exit 1; } echo "WAN: $WAN LAN: $LAN" LAN_IP=10.10.10.1 if [ -z "${SKIP_SYSTEM:-}" ]; then apt-get update && apt-get install -y curl dnsmasq python3 # 1. Static address on the LAN cat > /etc/network/interfaces.d/lan < /etc/sysctl.d/99-fwd.conf && sysctl --system >/dev/null # 3. Four things to remember: - **TUN takes everything**: `auto_route` + `auto_redirect` pull both local and forwarded traffic into `tun0`, and `strict_route` leaves no gaps; - **DNS goes into the tunnel too**: `hijack-dns` intercepts port-53 requests from Windows, then resolves them over DoH via `my-node`; - **The node IP is direct**, otherwise you proxy yourself; - **No hand-written NAT**: dnsmasq only hands out addresses (`port=0`); forwarding is `ip_forward`, and sing-box writes its own nftables rules. ### 3.4 systemd The apt package ships a systemd unit that reads configs under `/etc/sing-box/` and starts at boot: ```bash title="Gateway · everyday status checks" systemctl is-active sing-box dnsmasq # both should be active systemctl status sing-box --no-pager -l journalctl -u sing-box -n 50 --no-pager ip -br a | grep -E 'tun|enp' curl -s https://api.ipify.org; echo # should be ``` [![What the gateway and Windows each see on the network](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hychiiu/hychiiu-blog/assets/posts/claude-vm-vps/term-gateway.webp "Fig. 3 · The gateway routing table and Windows ipconfig (real output, redacted)")](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hychiiu/hychiiu-blog/assets/posts/claude-vm-vps/term-gateway.webp) ### 3.5 Kill switch This is the part that makes me feel safest: **there is no extra rule to maintain. The kill switch is the topology itself.** [![Gateway up versus gateway down](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hychiiu/hychiiu-blog/assets/posts/claude-vm-vps/killswitch-v2.webp "Fig. 4 · When the gateway stops, Windows is offline")](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hychiiu/hychiiu-blog/assets/posts/claude-vm-vps/killswitch-v2.webp) Windows has a single NIC, and the network that NIC sits on has no NAT, no host, and no DHCP server — only the gateway. So: - Gateway VM powered off or suspended: Windows has no route out, and **the network is simply gone**; - Gateway up, sing-box healthy: all traffic enters the TUN and leaves from the US VPS; - Gateway up, sing-box down: forwarded packets still have a `10.10.10.x` source, the gateway does no NAT, VMware NAT does not know that subnet, return traffic has nowhere to go, and it usually cannot get out either. The third case is only a fallback based on “there is no NAT rule.” It is not strict. If you want a belt as well as suspenders, you can add an explicit rule that forbids the private NIC from forwarding straight to the WAN (**I have not run this one long-term myself**; it is only a suggestion): ```bash title="Optional · /etc/killswitch.nft" table inet killswitch { chain forward { type filter hook forward priority 0; policy accept; iifname "enp10s0" oifname "enp2s0" drop } } ``` Load it with `nft -f /etc/killswitch.nft`. Traffic taken over by the TUN leaves via `tun0`, so this rule does not touch it. It only matters when sing-box is not running. > [!WARNING] > Debian's stock `/etc/nftables.conf` starts with `flush ruleset`. If you put the rule in that file and reload it, the tables sing-box created get flushed too. After a reload, remember to `systemctl restart sing-box`. ## 4. Windows: make it look like it “is in the US” Install no proxy software on Windows at all. Plug in the AI Agent Internet cable, and at boot it gets a `10.10.10.1xx` address from the gateway, with both the gateway and DNS set to `10.10.10.1`. What is left is making the system environment match the egress. The egress is in the US West, so Windows should use Pacific Time: [![How egress location, the Windows timezone, and the language line up](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hychiiu/hychiiu-blog/assets/posts/claude-vm-vps/timezone-v2.webp "Fig. 5 · The clock follows the egress")](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hychiiu/hychiiu-blog/assets/posts/claude-vm-vps/timezone-v2.webp) ```powershell title="Windows · timezone" tzutil /g # current timezone ID tzutil /s "Pacific Standard Time" # (UTC-08:00) Pacific Time (US & Canada); DST switches automatically Get-TimeZone ``` Language needed almost no work. The system was already an English edition, so I left the display language as English (United States), which already matches the egress, and only added Chinese as an input method so I can still type comfortably: ```powershell title="Windows · language and input" Get-WinSystemLocale Get-Culture Get-WinUserLanguageList # Keep the English UI, then add Chinese input $list = Get-WinUserLanguageList $list.Add("zh-CN") Set-WinUserLanguageList $list -Force ``` > [!WARNING] > I would turn off “Set time zone automatically” in Settings. It guesses from location services, the guess may not match the egress, and one day it can silently flip back to UTC+8 without you noticing. ## 5. CLIProxyAPI: sign in once on Windows, use it everywhere else The environment is clean, but I cannot do all my work inside the VM. Claude Code in the Mac terminal, and other computers, should use the same account. If every device signs in on its own, we are back to “here today, there tomorrow.” So I also run [CLIProxyAPI](https://github.com/router-for-me/CLIProxyAPI) (CPA below) on the same VPS. It can sign into a Claude Code account over OAuth and expose it as an Anthropic / OpenAI-compatible API. The split is: - **Sign in only once, and do it on Windows.** That request takes the clean path, so the browser, timezone, and egress all line up; - **Credentials stay on the VPS.** CPA stores the OAuth tokens in its own auth directory and refreshes them itself; - **Every other device only holds an API key.** They talk to CPA, CPA talks to Claude from the VPS, so the egress Claude sees is still this VPS — the same one Windows uses. [![CPA: sign in once on Windows, call it with an API key from other devices](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hychiiu/hychiiu-blog/assets/posts/claude-vm-vps/cpa-flow.webp "Fig. 6 · Sign in once, call it from anywhere")](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hychiiu/hychiiu-blog/assets/posts/claude-vm-vps/cpa-flow.webp) ### 5.1 Deploying it I run the official `eceasy/cli-proxy-api` image with Docker Compose. The port is bound to localhost only; Caddy terminates HTTPS in front of it: ```yaml title="VPS · docker-compose.yml (excerpt)" services: cli-proxy-api: image: eceasy/cli-proxy-api:latest restart: unless-stopped ports: - "127.0.0.1::" # only for Caddy on this host environment: - TZ=America/Los_Angeles volumes: - ./cli-proxy-api/config.yaml:/CLIProxyAPI/config.yaml - ./cli-proxy-api/auth:/root/.cli-proxy-api # OAuth credentials live here - /etc/localtime:/etc/localtime:ro ``` Copy `config.example.yaml` from the repo to `config.yaml` and change these fields to get it running: ```yaml title="VPS · config.yaml (excerpt, v8 schema)" config-version: 8 server: port: management: allow-remote: true # only needed if you open the admin panel from another machine secret-key: "" access: api-keys: - "" # the key clients use, not a Claude key ``` ```text title="VPS · /etc/caddy/Caddyfile" { reverse_proxy 127.0.0.1: } ``` After `docker compose up -d`, glance at `docker compose logs -f cli-proxy-api` and make sure it is not erroring. > [!TIP] > Three small traps here: > 1. If `api-keys` is still the placeholder from the example, CPA enters a safe mode and disables the API. Replace it with your own key before using it; > 2. For the container timezone, `TZ` plus a bind-mount of `/etc/localtime` is enough. Do not also mount `/etc/timezone` — that fails with `not a directory`; > 3. If the Caddy config writes a log file, create `/var/log/caddy` first and `chown caddy:caddy`, or Caddy will not start. ### 5.2 Signing in from Windows This is the only step in the whole setup that needs a person in front of the screen, which is why I do it on the cleanest machine: 1. Open the admin panel in the Windows browser. CPA ships one at `https:///management.html`; log in with the `secret-key` above (I use the community cpa-manager-plus, which works much the same way); 2. Start a Claude OAuth login from the panel, get the authorization URL, open it in **the same browser**, sign in, and approve it; 3. After approval the browser jumps to a `localhost` callback. CPA is not running on Windows, so that page usually will not load. Ignore it, copy the full URL from the address bar, and paste it back into the panel; 4. When the account appears in the panel and looks healthy, you are signed in. ### 5.3 Using it from other devices Claude Code only needs two environment variables: ```bash title="Any device · Claude Code" export ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL="https://" export ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN="" claude ``` For an OpenAI-compatible client, set the Base URL to `https:///v1` and use the same key. Confirm it with a curl first: ```bash curl -s https:///v1/models -H "Authorization: Bearer " ``` > [!CAUTION] > CPA sits in front of your own account. Keep the API key and the management secret long, and do not share them. This setup is for your own devices. Do not hand it out to other people — it is unsafe, and it also violates the terms of service. ## 6. On the Mac: the TUN and the gateway fight over the path This is the section that took me the most time. My Mac usually runs Egern in TUN mode (`vif_only: true`), and it hijacks all DNS (`hijack_dns: *:53`). The problem is that **traffic the gateway sends out through VMware NAT looks, to the Mac, like ordinary local traffic**, so Egern's TUN swallows it and sends it out through some other node. [![The Mac TUN intercepts the gateway's connection to the VPS](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hychiiu/hychiiu-blog/assets/posts/claude-vm-vps/egern-bypass-v2.webp "Fig. 7 · Before and after the bypass")](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hychiiu/hychiiu-blog/assets/posts/claude-vm-vps/egern-bypass-v2.webp) That shows up in two ways: 1. **The gateway cannot resolve names.** Egern hijacks port 53, and the DNS that comes with VMware NAT (`172.16.236.2`) dies with it. I pinned a public DNS in the gateway's `/etc/resolv.conf.head` to get around that. If you ever see answers in `198.18.x.x`, that is almost always fake-ip at work. 2. **The REALITY handshake fails.** The VLESS connection gets wrapped and sent out again; on the VPS, the server log is full of `REALITY: processed invalid connection`. The most direct way to confirm this is to quit Egern entirely: the moment it is gone, the gateway comes up, and the cause is settled. I did not want the Mac to go unprotected just for the VMs, so the lasting fix is to keep that VPS IP completely out of Egern's tunnel and send it out the physical NIC: ```yaml title="Egern config (excerpt)" bypass_tunnel_proxy: - "/32" vif_excluded_routes: - "/32" ``` `bypass_tunnel_proxy` stops the address from being proxied; `vif_excluded_routes` is the one that actually kicks it out of the virtual interface's routes. The same idea applies to other clients: **add a DIRECT rule for the VPS IP, and confirm its route does not go through `utun`.** > [!CAUTION] > I got burned here twice: > 1. After editing the config I only clicked “Reload.” The routes did not refresh. You have to **disconnect and connect again** for it to take effect. > 2. I edited the copy I had saved myself, but the file Egern actually loaded was an old one under `~/Library/Group Containers/…/Local/`, which did not have the rule at all. Before editing, confirm which file it is really using. The check is simple: on the Mac, run `route -n get ` and confirm the egress interface is a physical one such as `en0`, not `utun*`. ## 7. Let the gateway run quietly in the background The gateway does not need a GUI, and an extra Fusion window every time is annoying. Fusion ships `vmrun`, which can start a VM headless: ```bash title="Mac · ~/.zshrc" VMRUN="/Applications/VMware Fusion.app/Contents/Library/vmrun" GW_VMX="$HOME/Virtual Machines.localized/Debian 12 AI Agent Gateway.vmwarevm/Debian 12 AI Agent Gateway.vmx" alias gw-up='"$VMRUN" -T fusion start "$GW_VMX" nogui' alias gw-down='"$VMRUN" -T fusion stop "$GW_VMX" soft' alias gw-ip='"$VMRUN" -T fusion getGuestIPAddress "$GW_VMX" -wait' alias vms='"$VMRUN" list' ``` Day to day I run `gw-up`, wait a dozen seconds, then start Windows. To get onto the gateway I `ssh hychiiu@`; `gw-ip` will tell you its address on `172.16.236.x`. > [!TIP] > Start **the gateway first, then Windows**. The other way around is fine too, except Windows will not get a DHCP address at first — once the gateway is up, run `ipconfig /renew` in Windows and it is done. ## 8. A few notes about Claude Once the environment is in place, the Claude account is signed in only on this Windows machine, including the one authorization granted to CPA. Other devices use only the CPA key and never sign in directly. A few things I have learned: - **A fixed egress matters more than anything else.** The same account showing up in one country today and another tomorrow is a better way to get into trouble than which VPS vendor you picked. Now, whether it is the Windows browser or a request sent through CPA, there is only this one US egress. - **Align timezone and language with the egress.** That is what section 4 is for. You do not need to be obsessive, but “IP in the US, system clock on Beijing time” is the kind of contradiction anyone can spot at a glance. - **Claude Code on the Mac goes through CPA.** It does not traverse the VM gateway; `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` points at my own CPA. I hit a trap earlier with a third-party relay: some relays only accept requests from the official CLI, and requests from Claude Code Desktop get rejected, with a preflight message that says “please upgrade Claude Code.” That is not a version problem — switch back to the CLI and it is fine. I am still figuring out how Desktop should talk to a self-hosted service, and I will write that up when I have a conclusion. ## 10. Traps I have already stepped in Here is a symptom → cause → fix table for the problems I ran into in this period, so next time I can look them up directly: | Symptom | Cause | Fix | | --- | --- | --- | | `install.sh` dies halfway through installing sing-box | GitHub API rate limit | Install from the `deb.sagernet.org` apt repo | | sing-box will not start, `missing default interface` | `auto_detect_interface` cannot see one on this VM | Set `route.default_interface` to `enp2s0` | | `sudo: command not found` | Debian minimal has no sudo | `su -` to become root | | Gateway can `ping 8.8.8.8` but cannot resolve names | Egern on the Mac hijacked DNS, so VMware NAT DNS is dead | Pin a public DNS in `/etc/resolv.conf.head` | | Resolutions come back as `198.18.x.x` | fake-ip on the Mac | Same as above, and bypass the TUN for the VPS IP | | Logs fill with `outbound/vless[my-node]: EOF` and `context deadline exceeded`, but the port is open | Traffic to the node itself also went through vless, so it proxied itself | Add `/32` as `direct` in the route rules | | VPS log `REALITY: processed invalid connection` | The Mac TUN wrapped the gateway's VLESS traffic a second time | `bypass_tunnel_proxy` + `vif_excluded_routes` in Egern | | Egern config changed, still broken | Reloaded instead of reconnecting; or edited the wrong file | Disconnect and connect again; confirm the config file actually in use | | All CPA endpoints unavailable, safe mode | `api-keys` still has the example value | Replace it with your own key | | Caddy will not start | Log directory `/var/log/caddy` is missing | Create it and `chown caddy:caddy` | | Worried that changing the timezone would break the handshake | It will not | TLS / REALITY care whether the UTC clock is accurate, not which timezone you display | [![The outage I chased down](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hychiiu/hychiiu-blog/assets/posts/claude-vm-vps/term-debug-v2.webp "Fig. 9 · Services are up, but nothing gets out (real output, redacted)")](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hychiiu/hychiiu-blog/assets/posts/claude-vm-vps/term-debug-v2.webp) That outage was typical: both `sing-box` and `dnsmasq` were `active`, TCP to the node was fine, and the tunnel still would not come up. I stopped sing-box first and tested a direct connection, which confirmed VMware NAT itself was healthy; then I looked at the VPS logs and saw the handshake marked invalid; only then did I follow it to the TUN on the Mac. **Work from the inside out, one layer at a time.** It is much more effective than jumping straight to a new port or a new node. > [!TIP] > The most useful command while debugging: stop sing-box on the gateway, then `curl -s https://api.ipify.org` and see whether a direct connection works. If it does, the problem is in the tunnel or the node; if it does not, the problem is Fusion, the Mac, or something upstream. Remember to `systemctl start sing-box` when you are done, or the kill switch is gone too. ## Closing Looking back, two decisions are what actually made this work: 1. **Take “whether this is proxied” out of the workstation.** Windows does not know a proxy exists, so there is no such thing as “the proxy dropped”; 2. **Make “no network” the default.** The isolated net has no other egress. If the gateway is not there, nothing gets through. Safety does not depend on me remembering to turn a proxy on; it depends on the cable itself. The rest — sing-box, REALITY, timezones — is detail, and would still hold if you swapped in other tools. CPA turns “sign in once in a clean environment” into “use it anywhere,” with the same egress. To change nodes, run `sing-box url` on the VPS, rerun the script on the gateway with the new link, and you are done in five minutes. If you are building something similar, I hope this saves you a few of the traps. Questions are welcome in the comments below.
